facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; EU rules ban restrictions on payments.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Very likely: EU banks commonly offer foreign-currency accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register as a sole proprietor (FIE) online for €13; you must live in Estonia.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at a flat 22%, plus social tax for the self-employed.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 24% VAT once turnover in Estonia passes €40,000 a year.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can withdraw within 14 days.
facts.L7_incentives: Entrepreneur account at LHV: flat 20% on receipts, no bookkeeping, up to €40,000.

watch_out.text: e-Residency doesn't let you work as an FIE from abroad.
The entrepreneur account taxes gross receipts; no expenses are deducted.
